career.title: Career of Joseph A. Simon, Criminal Defense Attorney
career.description: Joe has over 30 years of of excellence in criminal defense in Washtenaw and surrounding counties. He was named a top 10 criminal defense attorney in Michigan.
career.heading: Joseph A. Simon's Career
career.bodyHtml: Through a career spanning more than 30 years, few lawyers can match Mr. Simon's experience, reputation and results. He has tried hundreds of criminal cases throughout the state of Michigan establishing a reputation for excellence and providing vigorous and successful defenses to individuals throughout Washtenaw, Wayne, Jackson, Lenawee and Livingston counties in a wide range of criminal defense cases, including those involving OWI and DUI charges, domestic assault, assault & battery, theft offenses, traffic offenses, homicide allegations and alleged drug crimes. Scroll down to view some of Mr. Simon's career in the media.
